content.text: uni_owns_option_to_assign means university owns results and company has an option to take full ownership. This still preserves university ownership initially and publication rights. It's not a hard limit violation. The key concern is publication rights - with option to assign, once assigned the company owns it, but academic use rights should be negotiated at assignment time. However, this is within acceptable Lambert models and no hard limit is crossed. I'll accept.
